comments: Input facts: ego is the car initiator; agent1 is the pedestrian responder; the group permits stationary non-crossing trafficway occupancy. Chosen assumptions: agent1 stands within the driving lane near its right edge, 10-12 m ahead and 1.45-1.65 m right of the centerline. Ego initiates a close parallel pass at 4-5 m/s for 6 s, then brakes with input 0.65-0.85. Require initial lateral body clearance of 0.10-0.35 m; agent1 remains stationary without crossing. Outcome intent: conflict opportunity, with no collision requirement. All realizations use stationary pedestrians because the schema provides no parallel-walking pedestrian maneuver.
